name: Waimakariri Biodiversity Contestable Fund
summary: Annual council fund for individuals and groups protecting, maintaining, restoring or recreating significant indigenous biodiversity in the Waimakariri District, with first priority for significant natural areas and covenants.
reporting: An Accountability Form must be returned on completion before the grant is paid.

status.quote: Applications are open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

opens.quote: Applications are open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications are open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The fund is open to individuals or groups for projects protecting, maintaining, restoring, or recreating areas of significant indigenous biodiversity in the Waimakariri District.

geography.quote: The fund is open to individuals or groups for projects protecting, maintaining, restoring, or recreating areas of significant indigenous biodiversity in the Waimakariri District.

access.quote: Applications can be made by sending a completed copy of the Biodiversity Contestable Fund Application Form to biodiversity@wmk.govt.nz

window.quote: The Biodiversity Contestable Fund will be open for applications once per year and funding rounds will be advertised.

co_finance_required.quote: Please note that the Waimakariri District Council generally contributes up to 50% of the funds required for a project.

reporting.quote: Payment of funds is by invoice on completion of the project and receipt of an Accountability Form.
